latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Bay Club Manager skill.

- Book and manage tennis/pickleball courts at Bay Club through automation.
- Invocable by users to check availability or make bookings.
- Uses a TypeScript script with browser automation via Stagehand.
- Runs booking logic through a shell command; user can pass date, time, and club as arguments.
